about: Cases for the one cover verdict: scripts/inspect/checks/cover_rule.py judge(), which the kit's placeBehind (src/system/scene/cover.ts) must give too. Each letter is [char, hidden share, ink box area, contrast or null]. fails lists the rules that fail.

cases.name: one letter just over the letter limit
a letter at the limit passes
every letter a little hidden: the word fails
one letter half hidden among nine clear ones
a hidden letter that reads on the cut-out (3:1) counts half
the word share weighs each letter by its area
